headline: Base Shifts Stall Across Front As Weathered Expanse Slaughter Mounts
war_summary: Over the past three hours, direct base transitions have ground to a complete halt across the entire front, yet bloodletting has escalated sharply into pure attritional combat. Weathered Expanse has surged to become the war's deadliest sector, absorbing nearly two thousand combined casualties in the last two hours as enlistment rates accelerate dramatically. In Dead Lands, where intense base trading marked earlier dispatches, frontline movement has stalled following morning skirmishes near Sun's Hollow and Liberation Point, though heavy gunfire still claimed nearly two thousand lives in the latest reporting window. Marban Hollow emerged as a fresh contested zone during the morning hours, recording multiple base shifts around The Spitrocks and Checkpoint Bua before combat settled into an active stalemate. Attrition also remains elevated along the coastal and central corridors of Loch Mor, Farranac Coast, Endless Shore, and The Fingers, where casualty rates continue to climb despite unchanged territorial lines. Meanwhile, rear territories and consolidated zones like Drowned Vale remain thoroughly subdued.
